model_annotation: Figure 4 presents the employment rate of women with and without a migration background in Germany. The x-axis is labeled “Alter” (age) and runs linearly from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-year intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Erbwerbstätigenquote in %” (employment rate in %) and also runs linearly from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 10% intervals. Two lines are plotted on the graph: a solid blue line representing women without a migration background and a dashed orange line representing women with a migration background. The solid blue line begins at approximately 20% at an age of 0 and increases to approximately 80% at an age of 60, with a relatively consistent positive slope. The dashed orange line begins at approximately 30% at an age of 0 and rises to approximately 70% at an age of 60, also with a relatively consistent positive slope, but starting higher and ending lower than the blue line.
